title: Sunshine Smoothie Bowl
subtitle: Cookbook Special • Low Calorie • Meal Prep Friendly
description: Delicious, high-protein sunshine smoothie bowl thick, creamy, and bursting with beautiful berry flavour - this sweet smoothie bowl is the perfect way to cool down on a warm summer morning. blend it up, pour it out, and make it pretty! prep: 5 mins k total: 5 mins ingredients serving v, gf, calories 235 protein carbs fat fibre 25g 30g whey protein powder (vanilla or strawberry) 50g frozen banana 50g frozen blueberries 80g frozen strawberries ioog unsweetened almond milk 3 blocks of ice 2g powdered sweetener* (optional) instructions i.add the protein powder, frozen banana, frozen blueberries, frozen strawberries, almond milk, ice blocks, and sweetener (if using) to a nutribullet or high-speed blender. 2. blend until smooth, adjusting the almond milk as needed for your desired consistency. 3. pour into a bowl, decorate with fruit and enjoy immediately! pro 4ip: save a few slices of banana & berries as prehy foppings/ no}es: from the healthy recipe collection.

instructions.text: Add the protein powder, frozen banana, frozen blueberries, frozen strawberries, almond milk, ice blocks, and sweetener (if using) to a Nutribullet or high-speed blender.
Blend until smooth, adjusting the almond milk as needed for your desired consistency.
Pour into a bowl, decorate with fruit and enjoy immediately!
